knowledgePattern: Optimise an exponential quadratic only on its attained inner range

hints.title: Rename the repeated power
hints.body: Use the base-2 exponential as a new variable and express the base-4 term using it.
hints.recap: Related exponential bases can turn a repeated-power expression into a quadratic.
hints.pitfall: The new variable has a restricted range inherited from its exponent.
hints.pause: Rewrite the expression and find the exact attained interval.

recall.reminder: Related exponential bases can turn a repeated-power expression into a quadratic.

hints.title: Compare only allowed inputs
hints.body: Complete the square and compare any permitted vertex with the endpoints of your interval.
hints.recap: An unrestricted quadratic minimum may lie outside the range of the inner expression.
hints.pitfall: A lower bound that no input attains is not a minimum.
hints.pause: Find and verify the least attainable output.

recall.reminder: An unrestricted quadratic minimum may lie outside the range of the inner expression.

solution:
1. Let u=2sin2x. Since sin2x attains [0,1], u attains [1,2]. Index laws give 4sin2x=u2.

2. The expression is u2−5u+7=(u−5/2)2+3/4. Its unrestricted vertex u=5/2 is outside the allowed interval.

3. On 1≤u≤2, the square decreases as u approaches the vertex; its least value is at u=2. The required minimum is 4−10+7=1, attained when sin2x=1. Answer B.
